claims: Dennis Gates is the head coach of the University of Missouri men's basketball team.
Dennis Gates has held the position of head coach of the University of Missouri men's basketball team since March 2022.
Dennis Gates is now in his fourth season as head coach of the University of Missouri men's basketball team.
Dennis Gates has led the University of Missouri men's basketball team to consecutive NCAA Tournament appearances.
Dennis Gates has a record of 55-46 over his first three seasons as head coach of the University of Missouri men's basketball team.
Dennis Gates is the 20th head coach in University of Missouri men's basketball history.
Prior to the University of Missouri, Dennis Gates was the head coach at Cleveland State.
Kellie Harper was named the head coach of the University of Missouri women's basketball program in April 2025.
